notes.title: SYREN v2.3 UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hey all, we have an update release for SYREN, which fixes a handful of issues that have been reported. Thanks for your feedback and patience, we hope you can now all enjoy SYREN to its fullest. 

In particular we have fixed the crash within one of the elevators in Episode 2, along with a number of smaller bug fixes and an Unreal Engine update, which should mean this new release will give you a smoother and more stable experience.

We hope you enjoy it, and look forward to hearing your feedback.

Thank you, Hammerhead.

notes.title: SYREN v1.8 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
This patch should address a wave of additional bugs that people have reported.
Most of these are small fixes but there's a few critical things such as screen mirroring now working on Vive and the second mermaid no longer popping into existence.
We're still working on offering more control options as you guys have requested but that's not something we can roll out quickly, however we are hoping to deliver sometime this week.

FIXED: Server room mermaid popping into existence fixed
FIXED: Vive screen mirroring now works
FIXED: Mermaid respawn timers changed from 30 seconds to 5 minutes
FIXED: Pause button no longer leads to empty space in title screen and tutorial rooms
FIXED: Level 3 keycard now easier to pick up
FIXED: Improvements to mermaid textures and lighting

FIXED: Shower glass material in level 2 now showing correctly
FIXED: Lighting in tutorial shooting range corrected
FIXED: Some interactive items would make sounds when held during free-locomotion
FIXED: Fans spinning on wrong axis in server room removed
FIXED: Multiple teleport beacons in same place removed
FIXED: Bubbles in Moon Pool coming through surface
FIXED: Removed teleport tutorial text from free-move tutorial
FIXED: Elevators now close fully
FIXED: Teleport mesh on tram now higher and therefore visible
FIXED: Mermaids no longer appear at wrong rotation for split-second during spawn
FIXED: Lift control panels now consistent across all levels
FIXED: Clipboard and tablet in level 2 now held correctly by hands
FIXED: Rotating wheel doors in level 2 easier to open
FIXED: Stopped objects generating noise while being picked up

notes.title: SYREN 1.7 Oculus SDK + Bugfixes
notes.notes:
We've got a new patch for the game to quickly address some of the more glaring issues people have reported along with adding an Oculus SDK version so the game should now run properly if you're using Oculus Rift with Touch Controllers. A more detailed change log is included below.

We're not done yet as we're closely watching all the feedback to the game and will be releasing additional patches in the coming week. Our top priority is obviously any and all bugs you guys are experiencing, however we've also seen a huge demand for more options in terms of how the free-locomotion controls work. So we're going to be looking to give you more settings to customize the experience to your preferences as soon as possible.

- NEW: Oculus SDK version now included for better support Oculus Rift and Touch controllers
- FIXED: Free-locomotion works better with room-scale to avoid issues of getting stuck in environment
- FIXED: Teleport now disabled in free-locomotion
- FIXED: Fire button no longer active on free-locomotion movement hand
- FIXED: First mermaid no longer leaps over pipe and clips through wall
- FIXED: Door button in Medbay now moves with the door
- FIXED: Rivet gun in tutorial room now in correct hand position
- CHANGE: Timing and collision window for attacking first mermaid much more generous
- CHANGE: Reduced file size of Easter egg movie

notes.title: SYREN 1.6 Resolution Patch
notes.notes:
We've deployed our first update patch due to community feedback about the visual sharpness. We've upped the resolution settings for normal and high, as well as adding a new ultra setting.

Our original setting were to try and give people the best possible frame-rates even on lower end cards so we were clearly being a bit too conservative with the rendering resolution to ensure that.

Rendering resolutions are now: low - 75%, normal - 100%, high - 140%, ultra - 200%. In future patches we'll probably expose this setting more directly to users but for now we wanted to give you better resolutions immediately.

notes.title: Release coming ASAP
notes.notes: Despite the timer above we're not actually 100% sure when we're releasing. Were waiting for final approval from Valve but once that comes through we'll be setting the game live. Hopefully it should be within the next 24 hours. Sorry for the delay and we thank you for your patience.
